body.description: a Stray, a six-wheeled machine the size of a large dog that comes out of storm drains at night: low battered chassis, one round red sensor eye glowing at the front, sun-bleached white paint with rust and a faded stripe, stubby antennas, menacing. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
